questions.question:
¿Qué función realiza el asistente inteligente de velocidad (ISA)?
What does the Intelligent Speed Assistant (ISA) do?
questions.help:
DRIVING ASSIST SYSTEMS
 
13 Intelligent Speed Assistant (ISA)
The system helps to ensure the driver is aware of and respects the speed limit, acting on the transmission system to adapt the vehicle’s speed to the limit on the road along which it is travelling.
 
(Página 92 del manual 'Learning to drive')

DRIVING ASSIST SYSTEMS  
   
13 Intelligent Speed Assistant (ISA)
The system is linked to the TSR system, using a frontfacing camera and GPS in combination with a digital map to detect the speed limit for each stretch of road, informing the driver graphically through the instrument panel. It also automatically adapts the vehicle’s maximum speed to the limits in force on each stretch of the road, and does not allow the driver to accelerate beyond the speed allowed.
It can be activated and deactivated manually by clicking on a button or by pressing the accelerator.
(Página 93 del manual 'Learning to drive')

7 ‘U’ turn    
7.3 Circumstances when it is prohibited to undertake a ‘U’ turn
It is specifically prohibited to carry out a ‘U’ turn:
At level crossings (although it is not prohibited in their immediate surroundings).
In tunnels, underpasses and sections of the road affected by the signal “unnel”.
On motorways and dual carriageways, except in the places designated for this purpose.
On one-way roads and one-way sections of roads.
In general, in all sections of the road where overtaking is prohibited, unless a ‘’turn is expressly authorized.
(Página 195 del manual 'Learning to drive')

Road traffic collisions          
   
7 Obligations after a collision
Any one implicated, present or has knowledge of a traffic collision is obligated to:
Help or summons assistance, to attend the victims, (if there are any).
Assist to avoid further danger or injuries from occurring.
Help re-establish, when possible, the flow and safety of other traffic.
Assist and relay the facts of the situation and how the traffic incident occurred.
Communicate, and inform (in all cases) your identity and that of anyone involved in the collision, when and if requested.
(Página 258 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.question:

questions.help:

3 Transport of load
3.5 Load size
As a general rule, loads cannot protrude from the vehicle floor: neither in front or in back or from the sides. It can protrude from the roof of the vehicle provided that it meets this condition.  
(Página 217 del manual 'Learning to drive')

Transporting people and loads        
         
3 Transport of load  
3.5 Load size
Also exceptionally, in vehicles not exclusively designed to transport merchandise the load may protrude to the rear only as follows:
Up to 10 percent of the length of the vehicle, if the load is divisible.
Up to 15 percent of the length of the vehicle, if the load is indivisible.
(Página 218 del manual 'Learning to drive')

¿Qué indican las luces blancas traseras del vehículo?
What do the rear white lights of the vehicle indicate?
questions.help:
20 The reversing light(s)
 
The reversing light(s) illuminates the route behind the vehicle when it is travelling backwards (in reverse gear). It is also used to warn other users, behind that the vehicle that is reversing, that it is approaching them.
The reversing lights may consist of a single light or two lights that must be white in colour. These lights illuminate automatically when reverse gear is selected.
(Página 106 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
5 Vertical Signs        
     
5.3 Regulation road signs  
5.3.2 ‘Priority’ signs
R-2 Stop
Obligation for all drivers to stop their vehicle before the stop-line or, if one is not on the road surface or visible, immediately before the junction, giving way to vehicles that travel on the road they are approaching.  
(Página 124 del manual 'Learning to drive')

5 Vertical Signs        
     
5.3 Regulation road signs  
5.3.2 ‘Priority’ signs

If, for exceptional circumstances, a driver stops in a place where there is not enough visibility, the driver must re-stop in a place where he has proper visibility before committing himself to entering the new road. Consideration must always be given to safety.
Note: Failing to comply with the requirement to stop at a stop sign or give way sign will result in the loss of 4 points.
(Página 124 del manual 'Learning to drive')
